ios.desc:
“Rīgas satiksmes” mobilā lietotne paredzēta gan sabiedriskā transporta pasažieriem, gan autovadītājiem.
 
Biļešu sadaļā var iegādāties Rīgas sabiedriskā transporta biļetes, reģistrēt braucienus, kā arī uzrādīt aktivizēto biļeti kontrolierim. Pieejami vairāki apmaksas veidi – maksājumu karte, Apple Pay, Google Pay un internetbankas. Biļetes jāizmanto trīs mēnešu laikā no iegādes brīža. Biļešu sadaļā var apskatīt arī darījumu un braucienu vēsturi.
 
Sadaļā “Maršruti un laiki” iespējams skatīt transporta pienākšanas laikus pieturvietās, sekot līdzi kustībai reāllaika kartē, aplūkot kustības sarakstus, plānot maršrutus, kā arī meklēt sabiedriskā transporta pieturas un adreses.
 
Autostāvvietu sadaļā var apmaksāt “Rīgas satiksmes” autostāvvietu izmantošanu gan vienam, gan vairākiem auto paralēlās sesijās. Ir iespēja saglabāt biežāk lietotos auto numurus. Apmaksu var veikt ar maksājumu karti, Apple Pay un Google Pay. Nauda tiek rezervēta par plānoto stāvēšanas laiku, bet iekasēta tikai par faktisko, jo stāvēšanu iespējams pārtraukt pirms plānotā termiņa. Darījumu vēsture pieejama par pēdējiem četriem mēnešiem. Lai nepalaistu garām stāvēšanas laika beigas, lietotājs var iestatīt atgādinājuma biežumu par aktīvo stāvvietu.
 
Mums ir svarīgs Tavs viedoklis! Lai varētu pilnveidot lietotni un pēc iespējas labāk pielāgot to klientu vajadzībām, aicinām dalīties savā lietošanas pieredzē mūsu tīmekļa vietnē www.rigassatiksme.lv sadaļā “Sazinies ar mums”.
Mums ir svarīgs Jūsu viedoklis! Lai varētu pilnveidot sistēmu un pēc iespējas pielāgot to klientu vajadzībām, aicinām dalīties savā lietotnes lietošanas pieredzē mūsu tīmekļa vietnē
www.rigassatiksme.lv sadaļā “Sazinies ar mums”. Vairāk patīkamu braucienu!

android.desc:
The "Rīgas satiksme" mobile app is intended for both public transport passengers and drivers.
 
In the ticket section, you can buy Riga public transport tickets, register trips, and present the activated ticket to the controller. Several payment methods are available - payment card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and internet banks. Tickets must be used within three months of purchase. You can also view the history of transactions and trips in the ticket section.
 
In the "Routes and times" section, you can see the arrival times of transport at stops, follow the movement on a real-time map, view timetables, plan routes, as well as search for public transport stops and addresses.
 
In the parking section, you can pay for the use of "Rīgas satiksme" parking lots for both single and multiple car parallel sessions. It is possible to save frequently used car numbers. Payment can be made by payment card, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Money is reserved for the planned parking time, but charged only for the actual one, because parking can be terminated before the planned term. Transaction history is available for the last four months. In order not to miss the end of the parking time, the user can set a reminder frequency for the active parking space.
 
Your opinion is important to us! In order to be able to improve the app and adapt it to the needs of customers as best as possible, we invite you to share your experience of using it on our website www.rigassatiksme.lv in the "Contact Us" section.

quotes.text:
> I was in Latvia a few weeks ago. Riga’s one of the Europeans cities without a good transit link from the airport into city. Snooping around online, I found that the recommended way to get a ride was the use of an app called Bolt, a European clone of Uber.

Here's the bus that goes from the airport into the center of the city: https://saraksti.rigassatiksme.lv/index.html#bus/22/a-b/1541/map/en

Pretty much all public transport here is also covered by Google Maps, both the buses, trams and others (although I think the micro-buses might have a different ticket thing going on, I don't really ride those).

You can pay for the ticket with an app, by scanning a QR code on the inside of the vehicle (or inputting a code), allows paying with Apple Pay and other similar methods for buying tickets. A single ticket costs 1.50 EUR.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.flutter.rspassenger

https://apps.apple.com/lt/app/r%C4%ABgas-satiksmes-koda-bi%C4%BCete/id1584070455

Or just buy an e-talons card for any number of rides you need: https://www.rigassatiksme.lv/en/tickets-and-e-ticket/types-of-e-tickets/

On that particular route you have to press the button for them to stop at any given stop, but otherwise it's no different than any other public transport route.

Source: I live here and took that route in the last month.

As for Bolt and Bolt Food, my experiences with both have been fine. Though tbh both the rides and also food deliveries end up being way more expensive …
quotes.story_title: The special hell of Bolt, Europe's Uber clone
